wins: Maintained stable operational pacing with full reward capture across the single episode, demonstrating consistent response execution.
Actively engaged mentor support when uncertain, ensuring training data captured the decision points tied to failed success criteria.
fails: Unable to complete the core objective; every action ended without success despite positive reward accumulation, indicating misalignment between actions and completion criteria.
Triggered 10 mentor calls, highlighting repeated uncertainty around objective confirmation and lacked follow-through on remediation steps.
key_outcomes.summary: The run showed disciplined action sequencing but repeatedly missed the success gate, necessitating targeted refinements in objective verification and remediation actions.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Objective validation was never executed, so despite performing reconnaissance, no completion flag was raised and mentor intervention was required.

skill_cards.then_action: Reconcile action history against success criteria checklist and enforce mandatory verification task
